topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't believe this. I mean, seriously, who just takes something you poured your heart into and permanently etches it onto their skin without even asking? It’s like, if you love the work so much, why not just buy a print, or reach out, ask for permission? It’s your body, I get that, but it’s also someone else’s creation. Now, I’m supposed to be flattered? No, I just feel... I need to figure out what to do about this. This isn’t right. We’re talking about my art here, my expression, and it’s been, well, commandeered. What’s the etiquette for this? There should be some.
